rules.name: Quantity Has a Quality All of it's Own
rules.description: A Soviet force may include a free Rifle Squad (Inexperienced and Green) with all the upgrades aviable to them.

rules.name: The Great Patriotic War
rules.description: Whenever a unit should be destroyed by a Morale Check, roll again and take the second result.

rules.name: Not One Step Back!
rules.description: When a friendly unit fails an order test within 6" of a Commissar, remove one unit and reroll the dice and take the second result.

rules.name: Massed Batteries
rules.description: When rolling to determine a Fire for Effect radius, roll 2 dice and take the highest score.

rules.name: Baptism of Fire
rules.description: No Soviet forces can be Veteran

rules.name: Clapped Out
rules.description: Only Soviet Headquarters, Infantry and Artillery units can be Veteran

rules.name: Fanatical Defence
rules.description: An army chosen from this selector can make any infantry units apart from Shtrafbat squads Fanatics at an additional cost of +3pts per man

rules.name: Battle Hardened
rules.description: Only Soviet Headquarters and infantry units can be Veteran

sharedRules.name: Heavy Rocket Launcher
sharedRules.description: The Heavy Rocket Launcher fires HE (3D6) rockets rather than the usual HE(2D6) rockets. However, to represent the fact that it is so slow to reload, when it fires it immediately suffers D3 pin markers. It must then be given a successful Rally order to reload it before it can be ordered to fire again.

sharedRules.name: Unarmed
sharedRules.description: Unarmed men neither shoot nor attack in close quarters - their only value is as casualties.

sharedRules.name: Vengeance
sharedRules.description: If the enemy force includes and SS units, partisans count as both Fanatics and Tough Fighters.

sharedRules.name: Inspiring Rhetoric
sharedRules.description: Inexperienced squads within 6" do not suffer the -1 to hit penalty for being Inexperienced.

sharedRules.name: Not One Step Back!
sharedRules.description: Political officers don’t confer any Morale bonus to nearby troops. However, whenever a friendly unit fails a Morale check or an Order test within 12" of a political officer, remove one model from the unit and re-roll the dice. The second result stands, as normal. This rule has no effect on vehicles and units that are reduced to one or two models.

sharedRules.name: SN-42 Body Armour
sharedRules.description: Small arms fire and HE suffer a -1 modifier to damage solidiers wearing body armour. The squad also advance ad run at a 6" rate.

sharedRules.name: Born in the saddle
sharedRules.description: This unit can fire their rifles from horseback as well as when on foot.

sharedRules.name: M3 Stuart Forward Facing Hull Mounted LMG
sharedRules.description: Note that these .30 cal machine guns are treated as LMGs rather than MMGs to represent the awkwardness of this weapon layout. In addition, these weapons must always be fired against the same target as the vehicle hull mounted MMG.

sharedRules.name: Home Ground
sharedRules.description: This unit does not suffer the usual -1 on its roll to come on from reserve or outflank. In addition, if this unit is deployng on the table at the start of the game it may be set up after all other units from both sides have deployed.

sharedRules.name: Cossack Spirit
sharedRules.description: Cossacks are not accustomed to strict military discipline and would often interpret commands as more of a suggestion than an order. Cossacks may never receive a morale bonus from friendly officers or be activated using You Men, Sanp to Action.

rules.name: Versatile
rules.description: The A-19 can also fire as a medium howitzer.

rules.name: Less than ideal
rules.description: When firing as an anti-tank gun the A-19 always receives the -1 to hit modifier as if it were firing at long range, and it never receives the +1 modifierfor firing at pointblank range.

rules.name: Snow
rules.description: Can only travel over snow or flat ice - which it treats as normal terrain traveling at the same speed as a wheeled vehicle, but with the same maneuverability as a tracked vehicle.

rules.name: Aerosan transport
rules.description: It can pull 5 ski troops as it's transport.

rules.name: Ampulomet
rules.description: If an ampulomet hits an armoured vehicle and fails to penetrate its armour, roll a die. On the score of a 6 the vehicle is 'on fire' as described for a damage result of 3 on the Damage results on Armoured Targets on page 87 of the Bolt Action rulebook.

rules.name: Intelligence
rules.description: Once per game, at the beginning of any turn before the first die is drawn from the dice bag. Roll a D6 and apply modifiers: Inexperienced -1, Veteran +1. On a 4+, the player activating the Intelligence Officer may choose a die from the bag for the first activation. If both players attempt to activate this ability simultaneously, each must roll 1D6. The higher score wins and immediately uses this ability, but the losing player may attempt to use his ability on another turn instead.

rules.name: Medical Vehicle
rules.description: Being in proximity of an ambulance means that any wounded soldiers nearby have a chance of being treated by a medic or stretcher bearer from amongst the crew of the ambulance .All infantry and artillery units within 6" of the vehicle count as within 6" of a medic.

rules.name: Little John Adaptor
rules.description:
+ 1 armour penetration. Cannot fire HE while fitted. 
If you roll a 1 (before modification) when you are rolling to hit then it has broken. The crew must spend one turn outside the vehicle removing the broken adapter before they can fire their main weapon again. Remember it is now  a normal light AT-gun.

rules.name: Gun assembly
rules.description: To simulate the fact that the gun was actually transported disassembled, when the gun is unlimbered the artillery unit suffers a pin. When the gun is limbered, the mule team (and consequently the transported artillery unit) suffers a pin.

rules.name: Stubborn (Mule)
rules.description: When taking an order test and doubles are rolled, the mules become stubborn and refuse to cooperate even if the order test was passed. Place the order dice to Down and add 1 pin marker to th eteam. This rule does not apply if Fubar is rolled.
